# TradeStation — How to Import Trades from TradeStation into TradeZella using the Option 2 Copy-Paste Import Method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/8602885-tradestation-how-to-import-trades-from-tradestation-into-tradezella-using-the-option-2-copy-paste-import-method

To seamlessly import your trades from TradeStation into TradeZella, follow these step-by-step instructions:



## Copying Trades from TradeStation:

- Open the TradeStation desktop application and log in to your account.

Open the TradeStation desktop application and log in to your account.

- In the TradeStation application, go to the TradeManager.

In the TradeStation application, go to the TradeManager.

- Select the "Orders" tab at the bottom of the screen. In the "Status" drop-down at the top, choose "Filled Orders" to filter the displayed data.

Select the "Orders" tab at the bottom of the screen. In the "Status" drop-down at the top, choose "Filled Orders" to filter the displayed data.

- Select the following columns in the exact order listed below:EnteredFilled/CanceledSymbolSpread TypeQuantityQty FilledQty LeftStopLimitFilled PriceOrder StatusRouteDurationGroup NameTriggered ByAdvanced Order#AccountOriginatorCommissionContract Exp Date

Select the following columns in the exact order listed below:

- Filled/Canceled

- Symbol

- Select the desired date range for the trades and click "Retrieve Orders."

Select the desired date range for the trades and click "Retrieve Orders."

- Change the sort order to Filled/Cancelled orders in ascending order (oldest first).

Change the sort order to Filled/Cancelled orders in ascending order (oldest first).

- Click the upper-left “square,” then right-click and select “Copy” to copy the data.

Click the upper-left “square,” then right-click and select “Copy” to copy the data.



## Pasting copied data into Tradezella

- Navigate to Tradezella:Open Tradezella in your browser.

Navigate to Tradezella:

- Open Tradezella in your browser.

Open Tradezella in your browser.

- Initiate Import in Tradezella:Click the "Add Trade" button on the left panel of your TradeZella account.Select the "File Upload" tab.Choose the TradeZella Account and ensure the selected Broker is TradeStation.

Initiate Import in Tradezella:

- Click the "Add Trade" button on the left panel of your TradeZella account.

Click the "Add Trade" button on the left panel of your TradeZella account.

- Select the "File Upload" tab.

Select the "File Upload" tab.

- Choose the TradeZella Account and ensure the selected Broker is TradeStation.

Choose the TradeZella Account and ensure the selected Broker is TradeStation.

- Paste and Upload:Paste the copied data into the "Data" box under the Option 2 dropdown.Click the "Upload" button to initiate the import process.

Paste and Upload:

- Paste the copied data into the "Data" box under the Option 2 dropdown.

Paste the copied data into the "Data" box under the Option 2 dropdown.

- Click the "Upload" button to initiate the import process.

Click the "Upload" button to initiate the import process.



By following these steps, you can efficiently transfer your futures trades from TradeStation to Tradezella using the Option 2 import method(Copy-Paste).
